pages.text: A madness in the mind keeps these serpon zealots following war wherever it goes.

You can summon this berserker by ritual, or borrow his aid for a while with a $(l:supreme/items/serpon_crown_focus)Serpon Crown Focus$().$(br)You can right-click your Serpon Rioter with $(item)Blaze Powder$() or a $(item)Blaze Rod$() to heal it.
